messages:
maria-ops: heads up — planning a phased canary to enable open-llm-x (v3.2) in the model catalog for eu-west. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. targeting 10% -> 50% -> 100%. @kevin-sre @sophia-ml can you validate fallback ordering and monitoring?
kevin-sre: thanks — quick clarification: fallback priority? do we fall back to quantized variant first or to redwood-v2?
maria-ops: plan is: primary=open-llm-x.fp16, fallback1=open-llm-x.quant, fallback2=redwood-v2. putting quant before redwood to keep latency lower.
sophia-ml: sound ok. perf targets: 95th < 180ms and generation quality regression < 1% on our eval set. I ran eval on a 1k sample — small uplift on hallucination but within tolerance.
ajay-eng: dedicated customers need pinning. we'll add a pin for dedicated clusters so they keep redwood-v2 until we sign off. can you add config?
maria-ops: yes — adding two toggles: catalog.enable.open-llm-x=true for hosted, and catalog.pin.redwood-v2=true for dedicated. snippet:```yaml
catalog_entries:
  - model_id: open-llm-x
    variants:
      - name: fp16
        priority: 10
      - name: quant
        priority: 20
    region: eu-west
routing:
  - route: default
    canary_pct: 10
    fallbacks:
      - open-llm-x.quant
      - redwood-v2
```
kevin-sre: nice. i'll add an automatic rollback rule: if 5xx rate OR latency_95 > 220ms for 5m OR quality_regression > 1.5% then rollback to redwood-v2 and pause rollout. deploy-bot pls implement.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: id=rb-deploy-2026-06-15-001, canary_pct=10, target_region=eu-west. scheduled start=1769127000.
release-manager: update release notes with recommended fallback order and dedicated pinning + known issues. i'll draft a short blurb and link to the runbook. cc: @ajay-eng for wording.
ajay-eng: wording suggestion: "Canary enabling open-llm-x for eu-west. Dedicated clusters remain pinned to redwood-v2. Automatic rollback on latency/5xx/quality regressions."
sophia-ml: monitoring dashboard check — i'll add two panels: 95th latency by model, quality delta vs baseline, and a canary traffic slice. alert thresholds: latency_95 > 200ms and quality_delta < -1%.
maria-ops: confirmed — runbook updated: steps for manual rollback, customer comms, and postmortem checklist. link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/model-catalog-canary
kevin-sre: i'll be on-call during the window 02:00-04:00 UTC. slack channel #eng-oncall. pager on if auto-rollback triggers.
release-manager: adding a note to the change window calendar and posting release notes after 100% rollout. also prepping a short status ping for #general at +30m.
deploy-bot: canary started: id=rb-deploy-2026-06-15-001, canary_pct=10, status=running.
maria-ops: monitoring live — seeing p50 fine, p95 ~170ms, no 5xx spikes yet.
sophia-ml: quality checks passing on the streaming eval set so far.
deploy-bot: canary update: reached 10% stable for 15m, increasing to 50%.
kevin-sre: increasing to 50% — keeping alerts on. if anything odd, i'll flip the pin.
ajay-eng: updated dedicated config so customer-facing endpoints remain pinned. pushed to infra-conductor.
release-manager: will file the post-rollout note after 100% and follow up with the product team.
deploy-bot: rollout complete: id=rb-deploy-2026-06-15-001, status=success, final_pct=100.
maria-ops: thanks all. closing the change window. if we see customer reports, escalate to #support. :thumbsup:
